title: Fix exceptions of positional session use in Edge provider (2)
body:
After https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/67661 I relaized that the sresidual finding can easily bew removed as all calling methods carry a session per default, so the `@provide_session` decorator is actually not needed.

This PR cleans it up
